# Rust GeoTIFF output fixture

The Web Mercator and TWD67 artifact groups are generated by:

```sh
cargo run --locked -p radiust-core --example rust_geotiff_fixture -- tests/fixtures/rust-migration/output/geotiff/field.tif
```

The first synthetic field has irregular EPSG:4326 latitude centers that become
a regular EPSG:3857 grid. The second preserves regular TWD67 geographic
coordinates as EPSG:3821. `tests/contract/test_rust_geotiff_readback.py` checks
both CRSs, affine transforms, float32 values and NaN nodata, uint16 quality
orientation, Deflate compression, and source/target CRS provenance through
Rasterio.
